approach.title: The NEWS Philosophy
approach.body: At the Middle School level, we follow the motivational philosophy of NEWS: Navigate, Explore, Work hard, Succeed. We create a learning environment that encourages curiosity, builds resilience and develops independent thinkers who are ready for the opportunities of high school and beyond.

values.title: Navigate
values.text: Discover possibilities and find your direction.

values.title: Explore
values.text: Be curious, ask questions and think beyond.

values.title: Work Hard
values.text: Build skills, practise with purpose and stay committed.

values.title: Succeed
values.text: Achieve your goals and create a brighter future.

curriculum.title: A Strong Foundation for a Changing World
curriculum.body: Our curriculum prepares students for the real world, with board-based question papers from Grade 6 to build academic strength. Each subject incorporates aspects of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) to instill strong values and a sense of global responsibility.

beyond.title: Enriching Experiences, Lifelong Skills
beyond.body: Beyond academics, students engage in enrichment programs like Vedic Math, Financial Literacy, Robotics, Taekwondo, Dance, Music, Pottery, Theatre, Public Speaking, Yoga and Life Skills. We offer specialised coaching in various sports that fosters physical fitness and teamwork. To strengthen English skills, we offer Public Speaking and Reading Classes that build confidence and communication. Current affairs discussions enhance awareness and analytical thinking.
